prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas. A square transparent PNG with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen equal square cells. Each cell has one complete standalone object in its central 60% only, with at least 20% EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTER on each side. Cell centers exactly at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Absolutely no pieces, sparkles, shadows, strokes or glow crossing cells. Graphic style: colorful contemporary AMERICAN SUPERHERO COMIC BOOK art, bold dark ink outlines, angular confident linework, saturated jewel colors, dimensional cel shading, shiny graphic highlights, small contained luminous accents. Friendly adventurous tone, original designs, no named characters, no logos. NOT photorealistic, no photographic texture, NOT emoji, no flat minimal icons. Each object must be COMPACT AND CHUNKY with approximately square or round overall proportions (width:height between 0.8 and 1.25). The OBJECT ITSELF is compact, NOT enclosed in a circle, cube, capsule, badge or tile. No bases, no backgrounds, no text, no grid lines. True alpha transparency.
